title: session-record
description: One line of a recorded relay session (JSONL), as check_session.py reads it. Direction is the relay's: in = received by the relay, out = sent by it.

t.description: unix seconds, when the relay received or sent the message

conn.description: a connection id; udp:HOST:PORT for a UDP sender

payload.description: text: the message as sent; binary and udp: the bytes as lower-case hex; open: {path}; close: {code} or null
